name: High Risk - High Reward Research
benefit:
1.	No budget limit is prescribed for this type of project.
2.	The research grant covers equipment, consumables, contingency and travel apart from overhead grants.
_eligibility_text:
1. Applicant should be an Indian citizen residing in India.
   1. The applicant(s) must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized institution.
   1. The proposals can be submitted by an individual or by a team of investigators. Proposals submitted by a team of investigators must identify a Principal Investigator, who will spearhead the research objectives and administer the grant.
